verdict.rationale: Logseq offers several programmatic surfaces: a local HTTP API server that gives authorized external access to the graph, a plugin API with community-written docs, and a logseq:// protocol that lets third-party apps invoke actions. None of the evidence claims or shows that these reach full UI parity, the plugin docs are community-driven, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: documented API coverage matching UI features (e.g. whiteboards, publishing, sync, export), an official machine-readable API spec, first-party API reference docs, hands-on corroboration of parity.
